qsc.support_gap: Installed QSC 1.7 is below the 8.0.6 release-note minimum 2.0.4. macOS/ARM is not a supported SDP development host.

kernel.scope: The boot kernel exposes package/version but no GNU build ID through use -i. SDK integrity is a separate check, not a byte-for-byte guest kernel comparison.

limitations: Release membership is checked against a locally cached vendor catalog; no catalog refresh or independent signature validation was performed.
Package inventory agreement does not hash every SDK file or prove vendor-supported installation.
Guest scan covers regular files in /proc/boot, /system/bin, /system/lib, /system/lib/dll and /system/lib/dll/pam; aliases are counted as separate paths.
Build IDs identify vendor builds; they are not cryptographic integrity proofs of every guest byte.
No execution-time robustness or real-time hardware guarantee follows from release alignment.
